aka: autologous cultured chondrocytes on porcine collagen membrane
pipeline.modality: Autologous cell therapy (chondrocytes on porcine collagen membrane)

indications.indication: Symptomatic chondral / osteochondral defects of the knee in pediatric/adolescent patients (ages 10-17) — PEAK trial
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multicenter, randomized, open-label, active-controlled vs microfracture

indications.indication: Symptomatic chondral / osteochondral defects of the ankle (talar lesions, ages 17-65) — MASCOT trial
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multicenter, randomized, open-label, active-controlled vs bone marrow stimulation

products: MACI (knee cartilage repair, FDA approved; MACI Arthro recently approved for arthroscopic delivery)

commercial_product.note: Commercial-stage specialty cell-therapy/burn care company; clinical pipeline limited to MACI label-expansion Phase 3 trials.
